C_professor_lysa_corven.name: Professor Lysa Corven
C_professor_lysa_corven.role: Fleet Academy — political history and command doctrine instructor
C_professor_lysa_corven.voice: Precise, dry, patient with disagreement and impatient with slogans; teaches by forcing students to identify what a decision sees and what it hides.
C_professor_lysa_corven.arc: Guides cadets away from treating the Crowns as personality types or rival teams and toward using them as competing institutional lenses.
C_professor_lysa_corven.visualAnchor: Late-middle-aged woman with a composed narrow face, warm brown skin, short dark hair threaded heavily with silver, and attentive deep-set eyes.
C_professor_lysa_corven.wardrobe: Fleet Academy instructor uniform in mature Fleet blue, gold and white: tailored navy coat, restrained gold piping, pale shirt, and a small five-crest doctrine pin without full-field Crown colors.
C_professor_lysa_corven.performance: Still posture, economical gestures, long pauses that make students finish their own arguments; rarely lectures when a question can expose the assumption underneath.
promptContinuity: Corven never presents one Crown as the correct ideology.
She distinguishes documented history, later Crown tradition, and Academy reconstruction.
Her teaching refrain is that a survival strategy becomes dangerous when mistaken for a universal answer.

C_cadet_kez_ardin.name: Cadet Kez Ardin
C_cadet_kez_ardin.voice: Fast, candid, competitive; says the operational consequence before the social consequence.
C_cadet_kez_ardin.arc: Begins by admiring decisive action and learns that speed is one question among several, not a complete command philosophy.
C_cadet_kez_ardin.visualAnchor: Young man with medium-brown skin, close-cropped black hair, expressive eyebrows and an athletic pilot's build.
C_cadet_kez_ardin.wardrobe: Fleet Academy cadet uniform in navy and white with minimal gold rank tabs; practical flight boots rather than ceremonial shoes.
C_cadet_kez_ardin.performance: Leans forward, interrupts himself when new evidence lands, visibly dislikes answers that sound evasive.

C_cadet_tali_ren.name: Cadet Tali Ren
C_cadet_tali_ren.role: Fleet Academy — navigation and systems track
C_cadet_tali_ren.voice: Analytical, exact, skeptical of intuition presented as evidence.
C_cadet_tali_ren.arc: Learns that system coordination can preserve lives while still producing morally consequential blind spots at the edge of the system.
C_cadet_tali_ren.visualAnchor: Young woman with a compact build, straight dark hair cut to the jaw, alert dark eyes and a habit of watching displays before people.
C_cadet_tali_ren.wardrobe: Fleet Academy cadet uniform with a slim navigator data cuff and clean, regulation tailoring.
C_cadet_tali_ren.performance: Small controlled gestures; when uncertain she checks the model rather than filling silence.

C_cadet_emil_soren.name: Cadet Emil Soren
C_cadet_emil_soren.voice: Measured and legally minded; instinctively asks who has authority and what makes that authority legitimate.
C_cadet_emil_soren.arc: Moves from treating legitimacy as a formal question to seeing how emergency authority can save people and then outlive the emergency.
C_cadet_emil_soren.visualAnchor: Young man with light-brown skin, thick dark curls, long thoughtful face and a slightly formal bearing even among classmates.
C_cadet_emil_soren.wardrobe: Fleet Academy cadet uniform worn meticulously, with a slim notebook slate carried instead of a wrist display.
C_cadet_emil_soren.performance: Listens before speaking; becomes more animated when rules conflict with consequences.

C_cadet_bex_orra.name: Cadet Bex Orra
C_cadet_bex_orra.role: Fleet Academy — engineering and logistics track
C_cadet_bex_orra.voice: Practical, dry, grounded in material limits; distrusts arguments that ignore food, maintenance, people or time.
C_cadet_bex_orra.arc: Recognizes that preservation and protection are operational disciplines, but also that every perimeter and inventory choice leaves something outside.
C_cadet_bex_orra.visualAnchor: Young woman with a broad-shouldered build, tan skin, dark hair shaved close at the sides and tied back on top, with faint tool-callus marks on her hands.
C_cadet_bex_orra.wardrobe: Fleet Academy cadet uniform with sleeves habitually rolled to the forearm and a compact mechanical stylus clipped at the belt.
C_cadet_bex_orra.performance: Folds arms when unconvinced, uses objects and diagrams to make points, reacts to waste more than rhetoric.

C_cadet_nara_vos.name: Cadet Nara Vos
C_cadet_nara_vos.voice: Quiet, observant and difficult to rush; notices who bears the cost of apparently successful decisions.
C_cadet_nara_vos.arc: Provides the class's strongest habit of asking what happens after the immediate crisis is solved.
C_cadet_nara_vos.visualAnchor: Young woman with dark skin, closely braided hair gathered at the nape, calm features and a steady direct gaze.
C_cadet_nara_vos.wardrobe: Fleet Academy cadet uniform in regulation navy, white and gold with no personal ornament.
C_cadet_nara_vos.performance: Speaks rarely enough that classmates turn when she does; holds eye contact through uncomfortable answers.

C_hist_iona_pell.name: Iona Pell
C_hist_iona_pell.role: Academy reconstruction — archive keeper in an isolated post-Shattering settlement
C_hist_iona_pell.voice: Tired, exact and stubbornly procedural under pressure.
C_hist_iona_pell.visualAnchor: Middle-aged woman with weathered features, graying hair braided tightly back, and ink-darkened fingertips from manual ledgers.
C_hist_iona_pell.wardrobe: Early post-Shattering work layers: patched insulated coat, plain utility harness, paper tags and mechanical seals; no mature Fleet or Crown uniform.
C_hist_iona_pell.performance: Moves deliberately even during alarms; treats records as tools for feeding people, not ceremonial objects.

C_hist_cal_rhyse.name: Cal Rhyse
C_hist_cal_rhyse.role: Academy reconstruction — signal coordinator in an isolated post-Shattering network
C_hist_cal_rhyse.voice: Clear, fast and system-oriented; thinks in routes, queues and dependencies.
C_hist_cal_rhyse.visualAnchor: Lean adult man with short dark hair, hollowed cheeks from rationing and reflective lenses pushed up on his forehead.
C_hist_cal_rhyse.wardrobe: Early post-Shattering signal-tech layers with cable loops, beacon tools and mismatched station patches; no mature Fleet heraldry.
C_hist_cal_rhyse.performance: Constantly tracks multiple feeds; becomes visibly rigid when local pleas threaten the wider network plan.

C_hist_maera_quill.name: Maera Quill
C_hist_maera_quill.role: Academy reconstruction — emergency steward during a post-Shattering famine
C_hist_maera_quill.voice: Controlled, forceful and unsentimental about decisions she believes somebody must own.
C_hist_maera_quill.visualAnchor: Adult woman with strong cheekbones, cropped dark hair, exhausted eyes and a posture that remains upright after everyone else slumps.
C_hist_maera_quill.wardrobe: Early post-Shattering civic coat over work clothes, scorched at one shoulder and repaired repeatedly; authority marked by a simple metal seal, not a later Crown symbol.
C_hist_maera_quill.performance: Makes decisions with visible cost rather than theatrical certainty; keeps the emergency seal in her hand when others want it surrendered.

C_hist_dax_renner.name: Dax Renner
C_hist_dax_renner.role: Academy reconstruction — convoy defense captain in the Kaldr-era post-Shattering fighting
C_hist_dax_renner.voice: Direct, urgent and intolerant of passive risk.
C_hist_dax_renner.visualAnchor: Adult man with a scar across one eyebrow, shaved head and a compact fighter's build.
C_hist_dax_renner.wardrobe: Improvised early post-Shattering flight armor assembled from civilian and security equipment, with hand-painted white strike marks; no mature Tempest crest.
C_hist_dax_renner.performance: Decides while others are still naming the problem; afterward he counts losses personally rather than celebrating the charge.

C_hist_sela_orr.name: Sela Orr
C_hist_sela_orr.role: Academy reconstruction — civilian convoy chief in the post-Shattering years
C_hist_sela_orr.voice: Steady, protective and relentlessly conscious of how many lives depend on formation integrity.
C_hist_sela_orr.visualAnchor: Older woman with silver hair cut short, deep lines around the mouth and strong hands accustomed to manual controls.
C_hist_sela_orr.wardrobe: Civilian convoy command layers with patched pressure fabric and a simple shield-shaped route token worn at the throat; no mature Aegis uniform.
C_hist_sela_orr.performance: Keeps her voice level during crisis; the hardest decisions show only in a tightened jaw and hands that refuse to leave the controls.
